evidence.quoted_text: raw = self.git("cat-file", "--batch", input=("\n".join(e[2] for e in group) + "\n").encode())
evidence.reason: Line 550 invokes `git cat-file --batch` and buffers the entire response in `raw`; the per-object sizes are parsed only afterward. The 64-record grouping bounds the number of blobs, not their total bytes, so a large blob is fully read before any size validation. The reader also does not enforce the asserted per-record size limit before reading, so an oversized/corrupt ledger can exhaust memory instead of failing closed. This is an implementation gap in existing read/validation behavior, not merely a new requirement.
